d.title: Lupin III: Ikiteita Majutsushi
d.jp: ルパン三世『生きていた魔術師』
syn: Lupin III: Return of the Magician
Lupin III: ~ The Living Magician ~ Return of Pycal
d.synopsis: Lupin steals an extraordinary gem from a Mediterranean party, only to be interrupted by Pycal, the trickster "magician" who had apparently died fighting Lupin early in his career. Pycal, now armed with real magical abilities, is determined to take revenge.
